name: Buffer Capacity
description: Increases buffer overflow granted upon merging Bytes by 5 per level.

description: Increases inherited base stats of newly merged Bytes by 1 per level.

description: Reduces the Energy cost of merging Bytes by 15 per level.

description: Increases inherited base stats of newly merged Bytes by an additional 1 per level.
